title: 21st Street over I-465 | detailed drawing-derived exterior
source_note: Official INDOT design plans, Contract IB-30026, project IM-465-4(382), dated October 15, 2007; 77-page extracted bridge/roadway plan package.
assumptions: This is an exterior design-plan reconstruction for visual review, not a fabrication, structural-analysis or as-built model.
All model lengths are metres. X increases with Line M station, Y is transverse north, native Z = elevation minus 730 ft. GLB transforms to (X,Z,-Y).
Deck station origin is Bent 2 station 13+00.08; profile PVI is 13+00.00 elevation 773.72 ft, L=600 ft, entering +3.728%, leaving -3.994%.
Drawing primary dimensions control the geometry. Approximate details are tagged in every relevant component basis/note and detail_coverage.
There is no reinforced-concrete bar or prestressing strand geometry. Internal U cavities, end blocks and interior steel cross diaphragms are included for intelligible beam form.

Negative residual camber values on sheet 49 are interpreted as final sag, distributed parabolically between supports; final field screed values were not included in PDF. Small top-flange end-corner conflicts are resolved with explicitly measured local surface relief to 1 mm below deck underside. This is a visualization fit adjustment, not an as-drawn detail; source deck, soffits, bearing levels and nominal depth elsewhere are preserved.
Mesh components may touch or overlap at intended assembly interfaces and simplified member connections; volumes are per-object visualization quantities, not a consolidated concrete takeoff.
MSE walls, pile positioning, ornamental fabrication arcs and some small edge treatments are approximate. Full roadway sheets 79-108 are not in this source PDF.
Printed sheet 63 was deleted, so PDF pages 63-77 correspond to printed sheets 64-78. All component pdf_pages are actual 1-based PDF pages.
Colours distinguish component families; exact historical coating colours and concrete weathering have not been colorimetrically reproduced.

parts.name: West cast-in-place full-width diaphragm
parts.basis: Dimensioned width; fitted to cap, beams, deck and approach slab
parts.note: Beam envelopes subtracted to keep concrete inter-girder volumes separate. Local joints and pavement ledge details simplified. Rebuilt: faces moved out to the cap faces, 1'-6" either side of CL Bent (sheet 58 sections C-C and D-D; previously 2'-10 1/4" wide); seated on the stepped cap top (sheet 42 keyway construction joint) where it had run 80-220 mm into the cap; the layer between the cap and each beam soffit left open over the beam bottom (pads and 7/8 in preformed joint material, sheet 42); refitted around the lowered beams, haunches and end blocks; approach slab ledge cut where the slab bears on it (sheet 58 C-C) (-1.471 m3).

parts.name: Pier cast-in-place full-width diaphragm
parts.note: Beam envelopes subtracted to keep concrete inter-girder volumes separate. Local joints and pavement ledge details simplified. Underside corrected to the preformed joint material of sheet 57 (sections V-V, W-W) and sheet 54: 1 in above the cap between seats and 4 1/2 in above each 6 ft seat (level with the pad tops), so the bearing pads and seats are no longer encased (-1.842 m3). Width corrected to 4 ft normal to the bent, faces flush with the cap faces 2 ft either side of CL Bent 2 (sheet 57 section V-V); previously 4 ft along Line M, 3.80 ft normal to the bent (+0.851 m3).

detail_coverage.detail: Two 116-ft bearing-center spans; 234-ft-1-1/4 floor; 51-ft coping width; 18-degree left skew; 600-ft crest curve and 2% crown.
Six 116-ft-5 beams with open U cavities, 54-in depth, 99.5-in top, 56-in bottom and 61.5-in opening; polygonal corner approximations.

Bearing elevations and tabulated negative residual cambers used with parabola; variable haunches fit final deck. Field screed data unavailable in PDF. Explicit local top-flange corner relief (maximum recorded per beam and in verification) gives 1-mm minimum deck clearance; nominal depth elsewhere, soffits and bearings are preserved. End-bent bearing levels are cap El. + 13/16 in (sheet 54); beam ends there lowered 3/8 in, haunches thickened accordingly.

detail_coverage.feature: Beam end blocks and concrete diaphragms
detail_coverage.detail: Solid 2-ft U end diaphragms and fitted cast-in-place inter-girder concrete; optional six-foot end-block void treatment and acute-corner breakbacks simplified. Bent 2 diaphragm underside on 1-in (cap) and 4-1/2-in (seat) preformed joint material; bearing pads and seats are not encased. Bent 2 diaphragm 4 ft wide normal to the bent, flush with the cap faces (sheet 57 section V-V). The sheet 54 plan line 3 in inside the Bent 2 cap face is not modelled: the 3'-8" 505a stirrups with 2 in cover (sheet 58) need the 4 ft flush width of section V-V. End-bent diaphragms are 3 ft wide, flush with the caps (sheet 58 C-C, D-D), seated on the stepped cap tops with the pad layer under each beam open and the approach-slab ledge cut.

24 distinct pad envelopes: 11x19x13/16 in at end bents, 14x20x4-1/2 in at pier; internal shims excluded. End-bent pads 13/16 in (sheet 54) with CL pads 1 ft 1-1/2 in from CL Beam along the bent (sheet 42); beams bear 3/8 in lower there than before.
L6x6x1/2 top/cross angles inside each U, at inferred symmetric 20-ft station pattern. Connection plates and bolt holes omitted.
12 actual rounded 36x18-in soffit holes, closed quarter-inch door plates, frames, two hinges, grab bars and simplified hasps; threaded/weld detail excluded.
Dimensioned three-column tapered bent, cap, pedestals and 51x13.5x3.5-ft footing; recessed 18-in running-bond courses. Wall/column interfaces, cap V-groove and corner drafts simplified.

Dimensioned 3-ft-wide skewed caps at source elevations; 11 nominal HP14x89 per bent at source 54/55-ft design lengths. Pile section gauge and longitudinal station distribution simplified. Cap tops are the three level terraces of sheet 42 with steps 9'-7 3/4" either side of CL Structure; cap ends parallel to Line M (sheet 42 plan).
Two 6-ft sidewalks, raised 8 in and pitched toward roadway; modified C parapets 2 ft 10 in above the sidewalk with thickened tops, approximate exterior recess indications.
W6 posts, pyramid caps, base plates, anchor nuts, 4.5-in OD pipe, rectangular rails, individual 3/4-in pickets, rings, stars and flowing graphics. Shop bay positions/arc radii simplified.
Actual A/B/C/D elevations and 1:10 longitudinal taper, individual footings, recessed masonry courses; variable transverse section and small asymmetric footing offsets simplified.
Limited end-wall envelope and 2-ft copings only; full panel layout, retained earth, extended roadside walls and roadworks are not reconstructed.

36-ft-wide, 12-in road slabs with square pavement ends: 32 ft 3-1/2 in long edge and 20 ft 7-1/8 in short edge (20 ft 6 in minimum); adjoining 6-ft-10 moment slabs to the same pavement-end line and Type 1A joint locations.
All reinforcing bars, prestressing strands, embedded anchors and internal bearing shims excluded by exterior-model scope.
Electrical conduits, handhole/service boxes, exact drip-bead grooves, engraved bench mark, drain holes, weld beads, nut threads, full joint seals and steel splice sleeves not modeled.
Design-plan reconstruction only; no field survey, fabrication shop drawings or as-built confirmation.

decisions.decision: Diaphragm faces flush with the cap faces, 2'-0" either side of CL Bent 2 (4'-0" normal to the bent), on 1 in preformed expansion joint material across the full width. Geometry unchanged from revision 1.2.
decisions.reasoning: Sheet 57 section V-V draws each diaphragm face as one line with the cap face and the 1 in joint material across the full 4'-0"; its 505a stirrups are 2 in inside each face. Sheet 58 gives bar 505a 3'-8" wide and 2 in minimum cover in all other parts, which needs exactly 4'-0". Sheet 45 gives the 4'-0" cap. The sheet 54 plan line 3 in inside the cap face (3'-6" between edges) is undimensioned, would leave the 505a stirrups 1 in outside the concrete, and sits on a detail drawn at 78 deg although it labels the 72 deg beam angle.
